description: Validate events. Pass contract_id to hit POST /v1/ingest/{id} (dry_run defaults true — no audit, quarantine, or usage). Pass yaml_content to hit POST /playground/validate per event (never persists). Exactly one of contract_id or yaml_content. 207/422 responses are returned as data so you can apply each violation's suggestion.

dry_run.description: Ingest only. Default true. Set false only after a successful dry run.

yaml_content.description: In-flight contract YAML; uses the playground, never persists

name: validate_events
title: Validate events against a contract
